{{Quote|I'm fine. Must be a touch of jump-lag.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars 3-D 3">[[Star Wars 3-D 3|''Star Wars 3-D'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Jump-lag''' was an affliction apparently caused by [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] jumps. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] once claimed to have had it after a flight to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jump-lag appears to be the in-universe equivalent of [[Wikipedia:Jet lag|jet lag]].
